subject: Re: credit memo & invoice offset for Acme POC
messages:
From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Request: credit memo & invoice offset for trial extension - Acme / POC

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the POC access — the team burned through the hosted trial credits faster than expected while evaluating the new caching behavior. Procurement is flagging an upcoming invoice (INV-10239, due 2026-02-28) and is asking whether Redwood can issue a credit memo to offset the amount attributable to the trial credits, and extend the trial window by 30 days so we can finish the performance tests.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can issue a one-time promotional credit for $5,000 to be applied against INV-10239, and if so, how that will appear on our invoice (credit memo reference, no refund).
- Any internal paperwork we need to sign (amended PO or statement) so accounts payable can clear the offset.
- If there are any tax or accounting notes we should provide to our finance team.

Attached is a usage export for the POC period for reference.

Thanks — looping in our procurement lead, Alex Park (cc).

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lowe
Finance Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.lowe@acme-corp.com

Attachments: acme_trial_usage.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: credit memo & invoice offset for trial extension - Acme / POC

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the usage export. Appreciate the heads-up.

We can move forward with a one-time promotional credit. Proposed plan:
- Issue credit memo CM-2026-045 for $5,000 applied against INV-10239 (will show as a credit memo on the statement; no cash refund).
- Extend POC trial by 30 days from 2026-02-28.
- Provide a short amendment to the existing PO indicating the credit memo reference and the revised net amount.

I’ve cc’d Hannah from billing so she can confirm the workflow, and Rishi for account lead visibility. I will start the approval path internally and paste the draft credit memo once finance signs off.

If that works for you, please confirm Alex can sign a one-line PO amendment or DocuSign to accept the credit memo application.

—
Marissa Cole

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Acme credit memo request — accounting treatment and GL codes

Team — forwarding Acme's request. They want a $5k credit memo applied to INV-10239 and a 30-day trial extension. Questions for finance:
- Is this treated as a contra-revenue/promotional credit for 2026-02 revenue, or should we treat it as a marketing expense?
- Would prefer to label the credit memo with a short note: "Promotional credit — no cash refund; applied to INV-10239." Does that meet requirements for AP at Acme?
- Please confirm GL codes and tax treatment so we can include the information in the PO amendment and final credit memo header.

I’ve attached a proposed credit memo draft pulled together to speed approvals.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: proposed_credit_memo_draft.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Acme credit memo request — accounting treatment and GL codes

Marissa — reviewed. Finance is comfortable issuing the one-time credit with the following controls:

- Classification: record as contra-revenue (promotional credit) in Feb 2026; do not recognize as refund expense.
- Journal entry: DR Sales Allowances/Returns (contra-rev) $5,000; CR Accounts Receivable / reduce invoice INV-10239 by $5,000.
- GL code: 4000-CR (Sales Allowances). Tax: no VAT adjustment is necessary for this credit since invoice tax on the net will be final — include a note "tax impacts reviewed; no additional tax due".
- Credit memo ID: CM-2026-045 (please use this ID in the memo and in the PO amendment).

Operational notes: Vivek will create the credit memo in the billing system once we receive a signed one-line PO amendment from Acme referencing CM-2026-045. Also include a short memo line: "Promotional credit applied to INV-10239; no refund issued."

I’m fine with issuance once the PO amendment is in hand. Attaching a final draft of the CM for your review.

—
Michael Grant
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

Attachments: CM-2026-045-draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@acme-corp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: credit memo & invoice offset for trial extension - Acme / POC

Hi Sarah — quick update and next steps.

1) Finance approved the credit as a contra-revenue promotional credit (confirmed by Michael). We will issue credit memo CM-2026-045 for $5,000 and apply it against INV-10239.
2) We need a one-line PO amendment or DocuSign acknowledgment from Acme referencing CM-2026-045 to satisfy our billing ops. I’ve attached the proposed credit memo and a PO amendment template.
3) Once we receive your signed amendment, Vivek will create CM-2026-045 in the billing system and the invoice will show net amount after credit (no cash refund).

I’ve attached the final CM PDF and a DocuSign link for the amendment: https://docsend.com/d/po-acme-2026. If Alex can sign today, we’ll get the credit applied before the 2026-02-28 due date.

Please let me know if you need any extra accounting notes for your AP team — we can include the GL code (4000-CR) and the journal entry text.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: CM-2026-045-final.pdf; PO-ACME-2026-01-signed.pdf
